dispositions.subject: combinatorics/permanents
dispositions.label: open/conjecture
dispositions.note: Wagner arXiv:2104.14516 §2.6 (HTML body read): Brualdi–Cao guess (per = F_{n+2}-1) disproved; best recursive-family permanent at n=10 is 394 while 312-avoiding constructions reach per=424 (optimal proved n<=8). If 394 is the exhaustive max over M_10(*,o), the conjecture f_312(n)=max over M_n(*,o) fails at n=10. The record's references field instead quotes UNRELATED §2.4 Collins peak-location prose — confirmed mismatch. See proposals.json.
